def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(range(10), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))
    active = [any(v != bg for v in row) for row in grid]
    starts = [r for r in range(h) if active[r] and (r == 0 or not active[r-1])]
    if not starts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r = min(starts, key=lambda r: max((c for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v != bg), default=-1))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    end = max(c for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v != bg)
    for c in range(end + 1, w):
        out[r][c] = 1
    return out
PY
